description: This file defines data conversion functions and related utilities for torch tensors, including type-specific conversion methods and complex number operations like complex and polar.

methods.name: _make_conversion_method
methods.description: Creates a conversion method for a specific dtype that converts a tensor to that dtype.

methods.name: complex
methods.description: Constructs a complex tensor from real and imaginary parts with dtype checks and shape broadcasting.

methods.name: polar
methods.description: Creates a complex tensor from magnitude and angle tensors.
